race.comment: Chris Waller is renowned as a pattern trainer and it is a strategy not limited to the big races by the looks of things. Last year he won this race with Tan Tat Delight, who was second-up after being a tad stiff in the 1203m 3YO maiden at Kyneton on Cup Day and this year he's got a carbon copy in FLYAWAY (6). He was held up coming to the turn at Kyneton, but finished nicely back towards the inside and might have gone close had he found clear air earlier. Draws out, but Lane sticks so looks the one to beat. ASTON (5) will find this much more suitable than first-up during Cup Week. Placed in town the last two runs of last prep, so is certainly good enough. PINAMALLOY (8) hasn't missed a place in four starts and is probably better suited by the step up in trip. Likewise WEEPING WONDER (9), who was a big drifter on debut but wasn't disgraced getting within 3-3/4 lengths of the classy Chandler.
